description: Base feature catalogue for the fraud-detection ONNX input. Adopters extend via `feature-catalog.adopter.json` (indices 64+).

features.name: velocity_1m
features.description: Sender transactions in the last minute

features.name: velocity_5m
features.description: Sender transactions in the last 5 minutes

features.name: velocity_15m
features.description: Sender transactions in the last 15 minutes

features.name: velocity_1h
features.description: Sender transactions in the last hour

features.name: velocity_24h
features.description: Sender transactions in the last 24 hours

features.name: velocity_7d
features.description: Sender transactions in the last 7 days

features.name: amount_mean_24h
features.description: Mean transaction amount, 24h window

features.name: amount_max_24h
features.description: Largest transaction amount, 24h window

features.name: amount_mean_30d
features.description: Mean transaction amount, 30d window

features.name: amount_std_30d
features.description: Stdev of transaction amount, 30d window

features.name: unique_receivers_24h
features.description: Distinct receivers in last 24h

features.name: unique_receivers_7d
features.description: Distinct receivers in last 7d

features.name: pair_is_first_send
features.description: First time this (sender, receiver) pair transacts

features.name: pair_prior_send_count
features.description: Count of prior sends from sender to receiver

features.name: pair_time_since_last_send
features.description: Seconds since the sender last sent to the same receiver

features.name: pair_round_trip_count_30d
features.description: Round-trip transactions between the pair in the last 30 days

features.name: pair_amount_mean_30d
features.description: Mean amount sent on this pair over 30 days

features.name: pair_amount_ratio_to_pair_mean
features.description: Current amount / pair_amount_mean_30d (safe divide → 1 if mean is zero)

features.name: graph_pagerank
features.description: PageRank of the sender in the transaction graph

features.name: graph_clustering_coef
features.description: Local clustering coefficient

features.name: graph_in_degree
features.description: Incoming edges to the sender's node

features.name: graph_out_degree
features.description: Outgoing edges from the sender's node

features.name: graph_community_id
features.description: Louvain community label (categorical, low cardinality)

features.name: graph_shortest_path_to_fraud
features.description: Shortest path length from sender to any known-fraud node (capped at 99)

features.name: graph_is_hub
features.description: Sender is in the top 0.1% of out-degree (hub/mule candidate)

features.name: graph_neighborhood_fraud_rate
features.description: Fraction of the sender's 1-hop receivers that have been flagged

features.name: amount
features.description: Transaction amount in base currency units (kobo for NGN)

features.name: amount_zscore_vs_sender
features.description: (amount - amount_mean_30d) / amount_std_30d

features.name: transaction_type_code
features.description: Encoded transaction_type (CASH_IN=0, CASH_OUT=1, PAYMENT=2, TRANSFER=3, DEBIT=4)

features.name: channel_code
features.description: Encoded channel (USSD=1, MOBILE=2, WEB=3, AGENT=4, POS=5)

features.name: is_cross_border
features.description: transactionCountry != home country of the sender

features.name: is_inflow
features.description: Transaction direction: 1 for INFLOW, 0 for OUTFLOW

features.name: is_recurring
features.description: Standing-order or recurring transaction flag

features.name: currency_code
features.description: ISO-4217 currency encoded (NGN=566, USD=840, GBP=826 mapped to small integers)

features.name: customer_age_days
features.description: Days since customerDOB

features.name: account_age_days
features.description: Days since the sender account was opened

features.name: customer_is_corporate
features.description: customerType == CORPORATE

features.name: has_kyc_id
features.description: Both idType and idNumber are present

features.name: id_type_code
features.description: Encoded idType (BVN=1, NIN=2, PASSPORT=3, DRIVERS_LICENSE=4, NATIONAL_ID=5, OTHER=6)

features.name: is_authenticated
features.description: Caller verified the customer (2FA / OTP / device-pin) before submission

features.name: recipient_has_kyc_id
features.description: recipientIDType and recipientIDNumber are both present

features.name: recipient_same_fi
features.description: customerFI == recipientFI (intra-FI vs inter-FI)

features.name: recipient_nationality_match
features.description: customerNationality == recipientNationality

features.name: recipient_age_days
features.description: Days since recipientDOB (0 when not provided)

features.name: recipient_lifetime_tx_count
features.description: Lifetime count of inbound transactions on the receiver

features.name: recipient_dispute_rate
features.description: Historical dispute / chargeback rate on the receiver (0 when no data)

features.name: customer_to_txn_distance_km
features.description: Haversine distance from customerLat/Lng to transactionLocation

features.name: customer_to_agent_distance_km
features.description: Haversine distance from customerLat/Lng to agentDevice location (0 when not agent-assisted)

features.name: ip_country_mismatch
features.description: IP-resolved country differs from customerNationality

features.name: txn_country_risk_band
features.description: Country risk tier from a static lookup (0=low, 1=medium, 2=high, 3=sanctioned)

features.name: is_cross_border_dest
features.description: transactionCountry != destinationCountry

features.name: sender_country_code
features.description: ISO-3166 numeric code for customerNationality (small-int encoded)

features.name: ip_is_vpn
features.description: VPN / proxy detected on the source IP

features.name: device_is_trusted
features.description: Caller has previously verified this device

features.name: device_type_code
features.description: Encoded device type (MOBILE=1, WEB=2, USSD=3, POS=4, AGENT_TERMINAL=5)

features.name: is_agent_assisted
features.description: agentID is present in the request

features.name: agent_battery_low
features.description: agentDeviceBatteryLevel below 20% — weak urgency signal

features.name: session_to_txn_seconds
features.description: Seconds between session start and submission

features.name: hour_of_day
features.description: Hour of the day in the sender's local timezone (0–23)

features.name: day_of_week
features.description: Day of the week (0=Sunday)

features.name: is_weekend
features.description: day_of_week ∈ {0, 6}

features.name: is_payday_window
features.description: Within 3 days of the 25th or 30th of the month (common NG payroll cycle)

features.name: is_off_hours
features.description: Hour ∈ {0..5} ∪ {23} — outside typical retail activity

features.name: hour_dev_from_sender_norm
features.description: Absolute distance from the sender's typical transacting hour
